evidence.reason: The launch-record write at lines 714-715 is outside the try/except/finally that owns cleanup for the just-spawned Popen child. If Recorder.append() raises, boot() propagates without entering the cleanup block: the child/systemd-run process is neither terminated nor reaped, and the qemu.log handle is not closed. That bypasses the existing exception cleanup and can leave an unowned VM launch path. This is an ordinary exception-safety bug; the smallest compatible fix is to put the record write inside the protected block so a failure runs the terminate/wait and log-close logic.
